_comment: Recorded with the deterministic HashingEmbedder at threshold 0.16, which is
the CI configuration. These numbers are a regression detector, not a quality
claim: the hashing embedder has no semantics, so its ceiling is far below the
real embedder's. Do not 'improve' this file to make the gate pass; re-record
it only when a change is intended, and say why in the commit message.
Real BGE-M3 results (1.000 across all four metrics) are recorded in PLAN 8.8.
